annotations.title: Get the AI email reply settings

description: Show one website's AI email reply settings: on or off, automatic replies or drafts only, the reply delay, the rules, the alert address, the forwarding address and how replies are sent. Needs the Pro plan or higher.

website_id.description: Numeric id of the website, from list_websites. Omit to use the account's primary website.
